title: Add ability to set Claude Pro/Max account by directory
body:
Hey folks!

Related to #1886 - I'm using Claude Code for a mix of personal, company & client projects.

It would be really useful to provide a way in the claude CLI settings (or similar) to have Claude choose which account to be logged in to.

This is only possible today when using API keys, which in turn means that Claude Code usage can't use my Claude.ai Pro/Max subscriptions.

Could you add a way to do this, for example by adding an option in `claude/settings.json` to specify the account / email to use, and then having Claude be able to retain/switch between multiple Oauth logins?
author: joshuaballoch
